name: A Donation of Wool
summary: Thunder Bluff is accepting wool cloth donations, and sixty pieces earn its full recognition for your generosity. Its stores need that amount from you, with further supplies expected from other donors.

sections.title: A Cloth Donation
sections.body: Thunder Bluff is gathering wool cloth. You can give sixty pieces, the amount its stores need from you, and earn full recognition for your generosity. The drive expects to gather enough from others in the realm to support it.

faq.q: What does Thunder Bluff want donated?
faq.answer: Thunder Bluff is accepting wool cloth donations.

faq.q: How much wool cloth should I give?
faq.answer: Sixty pieces of wool cloth earn full recognition from Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: What do I get for donating wool?
faq.answer: Giving sixty pieces of wool cloth earns you full recognition by Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: Why is Thunder Bluff collecting wool?
faq.answer: The donation drive is gathering wool cloth, and Thunder Bluff expects to get enough from other donors in the realm to support it.
